findings.claim: A repeat question withdraw of a recorded goal-bound question publishes to the goal every time; with the ledger unreachable it answers partial 'its goal does not show the reason yet' even when the goal already shows the marker.
findings.evidence: runIntentAskWithdraw repeat branch calls tellWithdrawal(before, now) first; endpoint or publish errors render untold; brief item 6d prescribes this order.
findings.relation: new; rule: a result's words state what holds

findings.claim: The plain-withdrawn Summary and the because row carry the reason verbatim with line breaks while the marker folds it; withdrawn person-act, lane-stop and recovery questions show the reason twice (headline via ClosedBecause and the because row).
findings.evidence: questionView appends c.Withdrawal.Reason unfolded; second case prints ClosedBecause, default branch appends the withdrawn rows; brief test (a) and S3 prescribe both.
findings.relation: new; rule: one fact is shown once and on one line

findings.claim: Machine withdrawals through channel.Withdraw (landing/plain, processchange) now keep a record, so their running waits end as withdrawn, but their goals are not told until a person repeats question withdraw.
findings.evidence: Withdraw delegates to WithdrawFor; only runIntentAskWithdraw calls tellWithdrawal; callers at landing/plain question.go:33, policy_question.go:356, steward.go:263, lifecycle.go:78, processchange setting.go:189, drift.go:183.
findings.change: none in U4; candidate for the later list

findings.claim: WithdrawFor writes the record as a second write after closeAt; a failure of only that write leaves a closed question without record that is reported 'was not withdrawn' and never told on repeat.
findings.evidence: WithdrawFor: closeAt writes the closed question, then writeJSON writes the record; repeat branch finds it closed with no record and answers unchanged.
findings.change: none required; improbable under the threat model
findings.relation: new; rule: a record is written with the act it records
